name: Claude Code CLI (RHEL)
description: Installs the Claude Code CLI (Anthropic) from npm.

agentVersion.description: @anthropic-ai/claude-code version to install. Leave empty to resolve the newest published npm version at install time and pin that exact version; it does not float on later rebuilds of the same layer.

pluginMarketplaces.description: Space-separated list of Claude Code plugin marketplaces (owner/repo) to add on container creation, e.g. 'anthropics/claude-plugins-official'. Best-effort: a marketplace that cannot be added is logged and skipped rather than failing container creation. Leave empty to add none.

plugins.description: Space-separated list of Claude Code plugins to install on container creation, as plugin@marketplace, e.g. 'chrome-devtools-mcp@claude-plugins-official'. Each marketplace referenced here must also appear in pluginMarketplaces. Best-effort: a plugin that cannot be installed is logged and skipped rather than failing container creation. Leave empty to install none.

pluginScope.description: Claude Code scope to install plugins into. 'local' records enablement in the workspace's .claude/settings.local.json, so containers that share a config volume (e.g. /var/llms) do not inherit each other's plugins. 'user' writes enablement into the shared config directory and crosses over between those containers; 'project' writes to the workspace's .claude/settings.json. Marketplaces are always added at user scope.
